name: KLA Corporation (Virginia, VA)
old_description: KLA is proud to be part of the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies 2026 list
about:
Headquartered in Manassas, Virginia, KLA Corporation operates as a global supplier of process control and yield management solutions for the semiconductor and electronics industries. The company traces its roots to a focus on electron and photon optics, sensor technology, and artificial intelligence, positioning itself at the nexus of raw wafer processing and next-generation chip manufacturing.

KLA develops and manufactures process-control and process-enabling equipment used across the electronics ecosystem, from wafer and reticle inspection to integrated circuit metrology, advanced packaging, and printed circuit board analysis. Its service organization fields over 3,000 field service engineers worldwide and maintains a global supply chain network stocking more than 250,000 parts and subsystems, supporting tool health, upgrades, and remanufactured systems through its KLA Pro Systems line.

The company serves semiconductor manufacturers, foundries, and fabless design houses across automotive, data center, mobile, Internet of Things, and artificial intelligence markets. Its solutions are deployed in fabs producing chips for advanced driver-assistance systems, high-performance computing, 5G infrastructure, and high-bandwidth memory architectures.

KLA emphasizes its role as an extension of customer operations, offering flexible service contracts, certified OEM parts, and technology upgrades that extend tool lifespan and optimize performance for each process node. The company states its mission is to accelerate tomorrow's electronic devices through innovation in inspection, metrology, and analytics.
